chapter: The Lunceford years: Europe, rivals and bandsmen
title: Never on dope; drug use among musicians
summary: Crawford says no one in his band used drugs and describes seeing an overdose in the hospital.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Did guys use much -- drugs as much in those days?
Did musicians use much dope in those days?

Perhaps so, but nobody in my band, in our band. I never was on dope. I don't see how a man can function himself and sniff cocaine and all that stuff. It was very expensive. I never in my life even saw anybody do it. Never. Oh, yes, I did.

When I was in the hospital trying to regain my weight, a fellow came in there, had taken an overdose, and been using it for usually sometime -- young fellow -- and I saw the doctors around him giving him another overdose to counteract his overdose, and so they finally got him out of it.
